title: Cheapest toll route across a grid
insight: LeetCode 64 Minimum Path Sum: row-by-row dynamic programming, each cell is its toll plus the cheaper of the cell above and the cell to the left
prompt: Please fill in CheapestRoute in route.go for the courier planner. README.md describes the grid, the allowed moves and the sizes involved. Leave the package name and exported signature as they are, stick to the standard library, and make sure `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` both succeed.
